audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Lord's Prayer, asking/seeking, Beelzebul controversy, stronger one, return of unclean spirit, sign of Jonah, lamp/body, woes to Pharisees and lawyers.

verses.restored: It happened while he was praying in a certain place, when he stopped, one of his disciples said to him, Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

verses.restored: He said to them, When you pray, say: Father, let your name be made holy; let your reign come.

familiar.text: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.

verses.restored: Give us each day our needed bread.

familiar.text: Give us day by day our daily bread.

verses.restored: Release us our sins/misalignments, for we ourselves release everyone indebted to us; and do not bring us into testing.

familiar.text: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.

verses.restored: He said to them, Who among you will have a friend and go to him at midnight and say, Friend, lend me three loaves,

familiar.text: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;

verses.restored: since a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him?

familiar.text: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?

verses.restored: And that one from inside answers, Do not trouble me; the door has already been shut, and my children are with me in bed. I am not able to rise and give to you.

familiar.text: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.

verses.restored: I say to you, even if he will not rise and give to him because he is his friend, because of his shameless persistence he will rise and give him whatever he needs.

familiar.text: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.

verses.restored: And I say to you: ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.

familiar.text: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

verses.restored: For everyone asking receives, the one seeking finds, and to the one knocking it will be opened.

familiar.text: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

verses.restored: What father among you, if a son asks for a fish, will instead of a fish give him a serpent?

familiar.text: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?

verses.restored: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?

familiar.text: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?

verses.restored: If you then, being harmful, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will the Father from heaven give holy Spirit to those asking him.

familiar.text: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

verses.restored: He was casting out a troubling spirit that made a man unable to speak. When the spirit went out, the mute man spoke, and the crowds marveled.

familiar.text: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.

verses.restored: But some of them said, By Beelzebul, ruler of unclean spirits, he casts out the spirits.

familiar.text: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.

verses.restored: Others, testing him, were seeking from him a sign from heaven.

familiar.text: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.

verses.restored: Knowing their reasonings, he said to them, Every reign divided against itself becomes desolate, and house falls upon house.

familiar.text: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.

verses.restored: If the Adversary also is divided against himself, how will his reign stand? For you say I cast out the spirits by Beelzebul.

familiar.text: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.

verses.restored: If I cast out the spirits by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

familiar.text: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

verses.restored: But if by the finger of the Divine I cast out the spirits, then the reign of the Divine has come upon you.

familiar.text: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.

verses.restored: When a strong one, fully armed, guards his own courtyard, his possessions are in peace.

familiar.text: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:

verses.restored: But when one stronger than he attacks and conquers him, he takes away his armor in which he trusted and divides his spoils.

familiar.text: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.

verses.restored: The one not with me is against me, and the one not gathering with me scatters.

familiar.text: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.

verses.restored: When an unclean spirit goes out from a person, it travels through waterless places seeking rest. Not finding it, it says, I will return to my house from which I came.

familiar.text: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.

verses.restored: Coming, it finds it swept and ordered.

familiar.text: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.

verses.restored: Then it goes and takes seven other spirits more harmful than itself, and they enter and dwell there; the last state of that person becomes worse than the first.

familiar.text: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.

verses.restored: As he said these things, a certain woman from the crowd lifted her voice and said to him, Blessed is the womb that carried you and the breasts at which you nursed.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.

verses.restored: But he said, Rather, blessed are those hearing the word of the Divine and keeping it.

familiar.text: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.

verses.restored: As the crowds increased, he began to say, This generation is a harmful generation; it seeks a sign, and no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah.

familiar.text: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

verses.restored: For just as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so also the Son of Humanity will be to this generation.

familiar.text: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.

verses.restored: The queen of the South will rise in the judgment with the people of this generation and condemn them, because she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and look, something greater than Solomon is here.

familiar.text: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

verses.restored: Men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and condemn it, because they turned/realigned at the proclamation of Jonah; and look, something greater than Jonah is here.

familiar.text: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

verses.restored: No one lighting a lamp puts it in a hidden place or under a basket, but on a lampstand, so those entering may see the light.

familiar.text: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.

verses.restored: The lamp of the body is your eye. When your eye is single/clear, your whole body is full of light; but when it is harmful, your body is full of darkness.

familiar.text: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.

verses.restored: Therefore watch lest the light in you be darkness.

familiar.text: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.

verses.restored: If then your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly bright, as when the lamp shines on you with its rays.

familiar.text: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.

verses.restored: While he was speaking, a Pharisee asked him to dine with him. Entering, he reclined.

familiar.text: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.

verses.restored: The Pharisee, seeing, marveled that he did not first wash before the meal.

familiar.text: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.

verses.restored: The Lord said to him, Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and harm.

familiar.text: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.

verses.restored: Foolish ones, did not the one who made the outside also make the inside?

familiar.text: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?

verses.restored: But give what is inside as mercy-giving, and look, all things are clean for you.

familiar.text: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.

verses.restored: But woe to you Pharisees, because you tithe mint, rue, and every herb, yet pass by justice and the love of the Divine. These it was necessary to do, without neglecting those.

familiar.text: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

verses.restored: Woe to you Pharisees, because you love the first seat in the synagogues and greetings in the marketplaces.

familiar.text: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.

verses.restored: Woe to you, because you are like unseen tombs, and people walking over them do not know.

familiar.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.

verses.restored: One of the lawyers answered him, Teacher, saying these things, you insult us also.

familiar.text: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.

verses.restored: He said, Woe also to you lawyers, because you load people with burdens hard to carry, and you yourselves do not touch the burdens with one of your fingers.

familiar.text: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.

verses.restored: Woe to you, because you build the tombs of the prophets, yet your fathers killed them.

familiar.text: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

verses.restored: So you are witnesses and approve the works of your fathers, because they killed them and you build.

familiar.text: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.

verses.restored: Because of this also the Wisdom of the Divine said, I will send them prophets and apostles/sent ones, and some of them they will kill and persecute,

familiar.text: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:

verses.restored: so that the blood of all the prophets poured out from the foundation of the world may be required from this generation,

familiar.text: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

verses.restored: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who perished between altar and house. Yes, I say to you, it will be required from this generation.

familiar.text: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.

verses.restored: Woe to you lawyers, because you took away the key of knowledge; you yourselves did not enter, and those entering you hindered.

familiar.text: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.

verses.restored: When he went out from there, the scribes and Pharisees began to press him fiercely and question him about many things,

familiar.text: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:

verses.restored: lying in wait for him, to catch something from his mouth.

familiar.text: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
